lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll work on two words that fluent speakers reduce to almost nothing at all. They are... …AND and OF! Function words compress; content words don’t: ahead of

English rhythm depends on compressing the small words between the stressed ones. Giving every word equal weight is what makes fluent speech sound mechanical.
